'''Mark of Darkness''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 59 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast.

When under the effects of the spell, the caster will gain various buffs for a certain amount of time (<math>(Y * 3) * 0.6</math> seconds), where <math>Y</math> is the player's base Magic level. If cast with a [[purging staff]] equipped, the duration is multiplied by five. With level 99 Magic and a purging staff equipped, the spell will last 14 minutes and 51 seconds.

Casting the spell results in the message {{Mes|You have placed a Mark of Darkness upon yourself}}. The player will receive the following message {{ticks|10}} before the spell expires: {{Mes|Your Mark of Darkness is about to run out.}}. An animation will play when the caster is no longer under the effects of the spell and the player will receive the message {{Mes|Your Mark of Darkness has faded away.}}.

==Mechanics==
Players under the effects of the Mark of Darkness will temporarily gain the following buffs:
* The bind chance of [[grasp spells]] is doubled, though the bind duration remains the same.
* [[Corruption spells]] will always inflict [[Corruption (status)|corruption]] on the player's next [[successful hit]], up from a 50% chance.
* [[Demonbane spells]] will have their accuracy bonus doubled (+40%) and an additional 25% damage bonus against [[demons]]. This is calculated after the player's own [[magic damage]] bonuses from their equipment.
** If attacking with a [[purging staff]], this is further doubled to an 80% accuracy and 50% damage bonus when under the effects of the Mark of Darkness.
